title: GUTI reallocation completion by the UE

entities.name: GUTI reallocation procedure
entities.description: Procedure where the UE receives a new GUTI from the network and completes the reallocation.

entities.name: GUTI REALLOCATION COMMAND
entities.description: Message sent by the network to assign a new GUTI to the UE.

entities.name: GUTI REALLOCATION COMPLETE
entities.description: Message sent by the UE to confirm completion of GUTI reallocation.

entities.name: GUTI
entities.description: Globally Unique Temporary Identity assigned to the UE.

entities.name: TAI list
entities.description: Tracking Area Identity list provided to the UE for mobility management.

entities.name: DCN-ID
entities.description: Dedicated Core Network Identifier for network selection.

entities.name: UE radio capability ID deletion indication
entities.description: Indicates whether network-assigned UE radio capability IDs should be deleted.

entities.name: UE radio capability ID
entities.description: Identifier for UE radio capabilities stored by the network.

entities.name: UE radio capability ID availability
entities.description: Indicates whether a UE radio capability ID is available.

entities.name: Tracking area updating procedure
entities.description: Procedure initiated by the UE to update its tracking area information.

entities.name: Network-assigned UE radio capability IDs deletion requested
entities.description: Condition where the network requests deletion of network-assigned UE radio capability IDs.

entities.name: Store DCN-ID in non-volatile memory
entities.description: UE stores the DCN-ID value with the PLMN code in non-volatile memory.

relations.description: GUTI reallocation procedure includes receiving the GUTI REALLOCATION COMMAND message.
GUTI REALLOCATION COMMAND message contains the GUTI IE.
GUTI REALLOCATION COMMAND message may contain the TAI list IE.
GUTI REALLOCATION COMMAND message may contain the DCN-ID IE.
GUTI REALLOCATION COMMAND message may contain the UE radio capability ID deletion indication IE.
GUTI REALLOCATION COMMAND message may contain the UE radio capability ID IE.
UE radio capability ID deletion indication IE guards by the condition 'Network-assigned UE radio capability IDs deletion requested'.
Condition of UE radio capability ID deletion requested establishes initiation of tracking area updating procedure.
Tracking area updating procedure includes including UE radio capability ID availability IE in TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST.
GUTI reallocation procedure includes sending the GUTI REALLOCATION COMPLETE message.
Presence of DCN-ID IE in GUTI REALLOCATION COMMAND establishes the property of storing DCN-ID in non-volatile memory.
